question:
Identify the correct synonym of the word given below.

FATIGUE
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fatigue"** means extreme tiredness resulting from mental or physical exertion or illness. (थकान)

 
 
• **Example: **After running the marathon, she was overcome with fatigue and needed to rest.
 
 
 
• **"Tiredness" **refers to the state of needing sleep or rest, feeling fatigued. (थकावट)
 
 
• **Example: **His tiredness was evident after a long day at work.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Fatigue' **is **'Tiredness'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mission **(मिशन): An important assignment carried out for political, religious, or commercial purposes.

 
 
• **Example:** The astronauts were on a mission to the moon.
 
 
 
• **Vigour **(जोश): Physical strength and good health.
 
 
• **Example: **He played the game with great vigour and enthusiasm.
 
 
 
• **Obese** (मोटा): Grossly fat or overweight.
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor advised him to lose weight as he was obese.
